Contamos con conocimientos en Ingeniería de Sistemas, programación, IA, redes e infraestructura tecnológica.

Buscamos integrantes con habilidades en desarrollo de software, astronomía, física, matemáticas, diseño UI/UX y análisis de datos.
summary:
ORBITAL NEXUS is an interactive space mission design simulator that aims to make space exploration and mission planning more accessible through technology, engineering, and scientific innovation. The project provides a digital environment where users can explore the fundamental elements of designing a space mission, including fuel requirements, trajectories, crew considerations, available resources, and scientific objectives.

By combining programming, engineering principles, and computational thinking, ORBITAL NEXUS encourages users to understand the complexity of space exploration while developing problem-solving and decision-making skills. Its goal is to transform complex aerospace concepts into an accessible and engaging experience.

This project is important because it promotes STEM education, inspires future scientists and engineers, and demonstrates how digital tools can support learning and innovation in space exploration.
details:
ORBITAL NEXUS is an interactive space mission design simulator developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It allows users to experience the complete process of planning, designing, launching, and operating a spacecraft through an educational and engaging simulation.

The platform works through six main stages: mission selection, spacecraft configuration, scientific instrument selection, communication system design, launch planning, and mission operations. Users must make strategic decisions while balancing mass, fuel, power, communication capacity, budget, and scientific objectives. The simulator incorporates simplified but scientifically grounded engineering models, including the rocket equation, solar power calculations, and telecommunications link budgets.

The project offers three difficulty levels, nine possible destinations, interactive spacecraft visualization, animated launch sequences, mission operations, and a 3D mission explorer with a virtual reality mode. It also provides technical feedback and evaluates each mission based on scientific performance, engineering decisions, cost, and survival.

ORBITAL NEXUS was developed using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, with SVG graphics and publicly available NASA reference data. It is a lightweight web application that runs directly in a browser and is published through GitHub Pages.

Its creativity lies in transforming complex aerospace engineering concepts into an interactive game where every decision has consequences. The project considers realistic mission constraints, scientific accuracy, accessibility, usability, and educational value.

The expected impact is to promote STEM education, encourage computational thinking, develop problem-solving skills, and inspire students and future engineers to explore careers in aerospace science and technology.
